title: State and Events
description: Learn how to manage dynamic data with state and handle user interactions with events.
longDescription: State brings your React components to life. This module teaches you how to declare and update state with useState, respond to user actions through event handlers, and apply best practices for predictable data flow. You'll also explore controlled components and how to build reactive forms.
whatYouLearn: Add reactive state to functional components using useState
Handle clicks, input changes, and form submissions with event handlers
Apply state best practices: keep state local, lift state up, avoid derived state
Build controlled form inputs that stay in sync with React state
